title: 多智能体知识库的审慎策展协议
summary: 提出一种针对多智能体知识库的审慎策展协议，结合知识工件生命周期、声誉加权审议投票和分级制裁三层治理。模拟实验表明，该协议在逆境下鲁棒性显著优于多数投票，性能退化速度慢约3倍，其中承诺-揭示投票隐藏机制贡献最大。
summary_en: Proposes a deliberative curation protocol for multi-agent knowledge bases, combining knowledge artifact lifecycle, reputation-weighted deliberative voting, and graduated sanctions. Simulations show significantly better resilience under adversity than majority vote, degrading roughly 3x slower, with commit-reveal vote concealment as the most impactful component.
